description: Wildland fire suppression rates is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. The Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry sets rates each year for the cost of aircraft, vehicles and equipment owned by the Crown and used for controlling or extinguishing a wildland fire. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Economy and Business, wildland fire fighting, wildland fire suppression, aircraft, personnel. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
